node.title: How to get data to an array?
node.author: buchi2
node.doctext:
Hello!

I have this:

my @data = [1,5,7,8,9,10,11,3,3,5,5,5,7,2,2]; as example, using it to give it to GD::Graph::histogram for plotting a histogram.
But now I have to plot several histograms and the data is coming each histogrammdata one line from a file.
E.g. my inputfile has as first line 1,5,7,8,9,10,11,3,3,5,5,5,7,2,2 But how I can read the line and assign it to @data?
I do this: (@histofeld) = split(',',$input[$i]); where @input contains line by line from my input. But it does not work, because it is taking the elements of @histofeld as a string.
How can I get it work?

Regards, buchi
